svg.title: Timeline 2014 to 2026
svg.desc: 2014: First contact with computers and tech; 2016: First Minecraft projects; 2017: Started coding, founded PlayGS; 2021: First certificates; 2023: PHP, Laravel, Linux, volunteer CMO; 2024: NodCord and the UplyTech API; 2025: VectoBeat and new UplyTech site; 2026: Started Tellersonne, VectolynCloud (Oct); LineFM in Flutter on the side (Nov/Dec)
